intention: Show the Remax FC-02 as the quiet companion ready before departure: its full display, integrated cables in their natural pose, and proximity to a smartphone signal instant readiness without clutter or search.
visible_link: The round digital display showing '100%' and the two blue braided cables — one looped above, one hanging along the side — are immediately visible and unambiguous, confirming the product is charged and equipped.
reason_to_care: You recognize the moment: leaving home or café with your phone, needing power but dreading the hunt for cables — this battery solves that micro-stress with what’s already there.
audience_use: People who rely heavily on their smartphones during daily commutes, work, study, or outings; they value preparedness and hate carrying extra accessories.
product_nature: A compact, satin-finish light blue power bank (20 000 mAh, 45W) with rounded corners, a circular digital display showing '100%', two integrated braided blue cables in fixed poses (one looped above, one hanging), and top-mounted USB-C and orange USB-A ports.
idea: A Namurois café table at morning light: raw wood surface, exposed brick wall behind, soft left-side illumination matching the studio photo; the Remax rests beside an off-screen smartphone, cables visible, display lit — no hands, no clutter, just readiness.
structure: Diagonal composition from top-left light source to bottom-right shadow; product occupies left third, smartphone in midground right of it, brick wall receding behind; negative space on right allows text reserve without crowding.
setting: A rustic wooden café table in Namur, with visible grain and slight wear, backed by an aged brick wall with subtle mortar lines; no signage, no branding, just authentic local texture.
materials: Unvarnished oak table, rough-hewn brick wall, matte-finish light blue power bank body, braided textile cables, cool-toned metal ports.
atmosphere: Calm, grounded, everyday readiness — the quiet confidence of being prepared before the day begins, without drama or artifice.
light: Soft natural daylight entering from the left, matching the studio lighting direction, casting gentle shadows to the right and highlighting the display ring and cable texture without glare.

text_reserve.description: Smooth cool grey vertical band, slightly darker than background, calm and untextured, offering contrast for white headline

elements.element: Exposed brick wall with irregular mortar joints, neutral cool tone
Off-screen smartphone lying face down, black glass back visible, 5 cm from Remax
Wood grain table surface with minor scratches and natural knots

resolution: No resolution needed: the concept fits perfectly within placement options and verified facts; all elements are permitted and coherent.
placement_why: LEFT_THIRD MEDIUM places the product clearly in the frame while preserving space for the smartphone and text reserve; the foot sits at 84% height, resting naturally on the table surface with visible shadow contact.
headline: Prêt à partir, sans câble à chercher
headline_role: Expresses the emotional relief of eliminating a daily micro-anxiety — the viewer sees the full display and cables, and the headline confirms the benefit they’ve just recognized.

palette_roles.surfaces: Brick wall and table surface, creating a neutral urban backdrop
Shadow areas under product and smartphone, grounding the scene
USB-A port visible on top of the power bank
Highlight on table edge and cable sheen under left light
Display screen background and deepest recesses

choices.why: Diagonal left-to-right flow mirrors the light direction and guides eye from product to smartphone to text reserve, reinforcing the ‘ready to go’ narrative without forcing attention.
LEFT_THIRD MEDIUM uses the measured box correctly (foot at 84% height), leaves room for smartphone proximity and text reserve, and aligns with the left-lit photograph.
Soft left-side illumination matches the studio photo’s lit_side, ensures display readability and cable texture visibility without harsh reflections or shadows contradicting the product’s pose.
COOL_GREY dominates to keep focus on product; NAVY deepens shadows for dimension; TERRACOTTA accents the orange port as a functional detail; WHITE and NEAR_BLACK refine tonal contrast per brand kit.
RIGHT_COLUMN offers clean vertical space aligned with smartphone position, using COOL_GREY for calm contrast — large enough for headline, far from product, no visual competition.
